QUOTE: If the embedder defines `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_NO_STD_FUNCTIONS` without providing those names, the defaults are stubs: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing (`platform.c:25-42`). Per `mbedtls_config.h:4113-4134`, an uninitialised calloc always fails.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the default stubs fail (calloc returns NULL, free does nothing) instead of falling back to libc, and that an uninitialised calloc always fails.
